description: This PHP source file implements a SOAP server for vTiger CRM, providing web service functions such as creating sessions, searching contacts by email, retrieving contacts, adding contacts and leads, tracking emails, checking permissions, and managing sessions. It defines SOAP functions, complex types, and handles authentication and authorization for CRM operations.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: SOAP server class instantiated to handle web service requests.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: Class representing contact entities in vTiger CRM used for contact search.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Class representing user entities in vTiger CRM used for authentication.

classes.name: Emails
classes.description: Class used for email-related operations within vTiger CRM.

classes.name: Accounts
classes.description: Class representing account entities in vTiger CRM used for account management.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Class representing leads in vTiger CRM used for lead management.

methods.name: SearchContactsByEmail
methods.description: Searches for contacts by email address and returns a list of matching contacts with details.

methods.name: track_email
methods.description: Logs email details sent to contacts, associating email activity with CRM contacts.

methods.name: GetContacts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of contacts with detailed information for the authenticated user.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new session for a user if credentials are valid, supporting version compatibility.

methods.name: end_session
methods.description: Ends the user session (simplified to a static success message).

methods.name: authentication
methods.description: Verifies user credentials for access to CRM functionalities.

methods.name: CheckContactPerm
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform actions on contacts.

methods.name: CheckContactEmailPerm
methods.description: Checks permission for contact email operations.

methods.name: AddContact
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the CRM with specified details.

methods.name: AddLead
methods.description: Adds a new lead to the CRM with specified details.
